title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows + optimize cache/parallelism
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: Our GitHub Actions asset set had grown organically which caused duplicate runs, inefficient caching, and a maintenance burden when bumping Actions and node versions. This PR consolidates multiple workflow files into a smaller, opinionated set, upgrades key actions (setup-node/setup-java/cache) to supported versions, and introduces cache/parallelism controls to reduce CI minutes and stabilize flaky jobs. Summary of high-level changes: 1) Consolidated .github/workflows/lint.yml and .github/workflows/test.yml into .github/workflows/lint-and-test.yml with separate jobs and a shared cache key strategy; 2) Reworked release automation into .github/workflows/release.yml to use a single canonical workflow with explicit concurrency, tagging rules, and fewer duplicated jobs across repos; 3) Introduced a cache-shard key that uses matrix.os/matrix.node-version and a small heuristic for lockfile-hash to avoid cache stampedes; 4) Added limited parallelism: test matrix now runs at max 6 parallel jobs and heavy e2e jobs are gated behind a conditional runner and retried on transient failures; 5) Upgraded node matrix to node 20, added a single lightweight node 18 job for compatibility checks; 6) Fixed a flaky integration test by increasing jest timeout and adding deterministic test data seeding. Checklist: - [x] Consolidated workflows and validated job ordering - [x] Upgraded actions to pinned major versions - [x] Implemented cache key sharding + restore fallback - [x] Added concurrency keys for release workflow - [x] Verified cross-repo release trigger still works in redwood-helm-charts - [x] Ran pipeline end-to-end and observed CI minutes reduction on sample branch. Notes: This PR intentionally leaves specialized long-running regression pipelines out of the consolidated workflow; platform teams that need custom tuning can opt into repository-level overrides. See ENG-4823 for perf targets and INF-211 for release policy updates.
commit_summary: feat(ci): add consolidated lint-and-test.yml with matrix and shared cache
chore(ci): consolidate release automation into single release.yml with concurrency
perf(ci): introduce cache shard key and limit test matrix parallelism to 6
fix(tests): increase jest timeout + deterministic seeding for flaky integration test
review_comments: Jared Kim: Left a couple of suggestions around cache key entropy - can we include a short hash of package-lock.json instead of full file contents?
Author (Asha): Switched to a 8-char lockfile hash as requested and added a fallback restore path for legacy caches.
Elena Rossi: The release concurrency key looks good, but please ensure the release job still posts back to release notes service. Added a small nit on secrets handling.
Author (Asha): Addressed secrets nit: moved secret references to environment-level usage and added a note in docs/ci/README.md.
Tomás García: Approved after verifying that the matrix parallelism limit reduced peak runner usage in our smoke run.
CI: triggered additional e2e retry after a transient failure; subsequent run passed and was noted in checks.
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows to reduce duplicated runs, improved caching strategy to lower CI minutes, pinned key GitHub Actions versions, and added parallelism limits to stabilize runner usage. No behavior changes to runtime code.
